page: Microsoft Azure D64ads_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Dadsv7 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V45 processor with 64 vCPUs and 32 physical cores, operating at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is bundled with a capacity of 3780 GB, and the instance supports Premium Storage. It does not include any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates top-tier single-core CPU performance, ranking in the top 10% for stress-ng single-core tests, gzip compression, and bzip3 decompression. Multi-core performance and memory bandwidth are strong, placing in the top 25% across both small-block cached and large-block uncached read and write tests. Database operations and Redis SET operations also register in the top 10% and top 25% respectively, indicating efficient transaction processing.

While the server achieves top-tier results for small and medium LLM inference models, its performance drops to average for large 70B models, highlighting a tradeoff when executing highly complex machine learning workloads without dedicated GPU acceleration. Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, high-speed AMD EPYC processor, and substantial local storage, this server is configured for database hosting, web serving, and general-purpose enterprise workloads.
